business_problem: While these behemoth agencies are often slowed down by complex layers of approval, Horizon Media turns its independence into a major advantage. The agency relies heavily on its core superpowers: structural agility, rapid decision-making, and unmatched operational speed.
solution_summary: Horizon Media accelerated its cloud strategy by deploying Gemini. This began with Agent Q—its internal workforce transformation ecosystem built with Gemini and connected to Horizon’s collective knowledge, which is one of the first such systems in its industry. Agent Q, along with Horizon’s AI-native marketing platform Blu, and expert teams providing the human intelligence layer, came together to form Horizon’s open operating system, HorizonOS. “Transformation isn't about a single app or a technology group dictating change from the top down; it’s about shifting your entire culture,” says Arenaro. “By deploying Gemini, we have empowered our workforce to securely build nearly 500 custom, no-code agents. Turning AI into a platform where our employees can creatively solve their own workflow challenges has completely transformed what we can achieve."
